pattern_explanation: Analysis, result and experiment come from Latin and Greek scientific vocabulary that both languages borrowed, so their forms stayed close across the two languages. The word transliterated as aktualnyi comes from a different root, although it sounds similar to English actual.
false_friend_warning: Learners may see the Ukrainian word transliterated as aktualnyi and assume it means actual in English, but it means relevant, pressing or current; English actual means real or true, so the correct English word here is relevant.
